entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The applicant who is in custody since 17.09.2022 has approa Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Korra P.S. Case No.211 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 414/ 420/ 467/ 468/ 471/34 of IPC.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on her part.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Learned APP has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.

Considering the period of custody, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/-
(Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned A.C.J.M., Hazaribagh in connection with Korra P.S. Case No.211 of 2022, subject to the conditions that the applicant will submit self attested copy of his Aadhaar Card and also give his mobile number before the learned court below which he will not change during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Shahid/
